display_long_description:
The ride of your life, from the seat - all the way round Baltimore, Maryland.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage in Westport. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto the street.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist back to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean into a corner. Tuck behind the screen for top speed, or turn wheelie control off and lift the front.

49 KM ROUND BALTIMORE
I-395 between Oriole Park at Camden Yards and M&T Bank Stadium, I-95 south-west, the Beltway up the west side past Catonsville, Woodlawn and Pikesville, then the Jones Falls Expressway down the valley past the Washington Monument into downtown and along Lombard Street by the Inner Harbor. Real roads, real hills, real landmarks.

ROAD EVENTS + SPEED TRAPS
Seven events on real roads - race for gold against your own ghost bike. Six speed cameras, and Rush Hour near-miss combos on the Beltway.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden hour over the harbor, bright sun, or the city at night on your headlight with the traffic's tail lights ahead.

YOUR WAY
Choose how much the view leans, bar vibration on or off, automatic or a six-speed sequential box. Speeds in mph. English and Spanish.
